name: Town Square recessed passage frontage
observations: Native270 shows a red/gold TOWN SQUARE sign with curved decorative crest above an open recessed passage.
Passage has brick returns, a deep shadowed ceiling/threshold and angled glazed display bays on both sides.
Raised brick/header zone and hanging red/gold vertical banner mark the entrance.
Upper windows are light multi-pane sash-like units; black gutter, brick chimneys and pale lintels continue along terrace.
The opening should be geometric depth, not a black texture painted on a wall.
Exact passage depth, destination and whether it connects internally to B028 are unknown.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
